algorithm: forward: independently scan each specified column top-to-bottom; replace an empty cell with the most recent non-empty value above, leaving leading empties empty.
backward: independently scan each specified column bottom-to-top; replace an empty cell with the nearest non-empty value below, leaving trailing empties empty.
constant: replace every eligible empty cell with value.

linear: for an empty cell at row index i, search upward by decreasing row index for the nearest non-empty float-parseable lower anchor (lo,v_lo), and downward by increasing row index for the nearest non-empty float-parseable upper anchor (hi,v_hi).
If both linear anchors exist, emit v_lo + (v_hi-v_lo)*(i-lo)/(hi-lo).
If only the lower anchor exists, emit v_lo; if only the upper anchor exists, emit v_hi; if neither exists, leave the cell empty.
Never modify non-empty cells. During linear anchor searches, skip non-empty values that do not parse as floats, but do not fill those non-empty cells.
edge_cases: Linear with exactly one anchor constant-extrapolates that anchor value.
Linear with neither anchor leaves the empty cell empty.
Non-empty unparsable cells are skipped as anchors and remain unchanged.

algorithm: Sort group keys ascending lexicographically and assign groupIndex as each key's 0-based position.
Set target to minimum group size.
For groupSize>target, create indices [0,1,...,groupSize-1].
Initialize rng with rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(seed + groupIndex))).
For i from groupSize-1 down to 1, swap indices[i] with indices[rng.Intn(i+1)].
Take the first target shuffled indices, sort them ascending, and select corresponding group rows.
For groupSize==target, keep all rows.
Emit groups in sorted-key order and selected rows in original relative order.
edge_cases: Groups already at target are not shuffled and retain all rows.
invariants: Every emitted group has exactly target rows.
Identical data and seed produce identical selection.
ordering: Sort selected indices ascending before selecting rows.
preconditions: Rows are grouped by the resample column.
